sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:

To play the game, you'll need to use your mouse, keyboard, or touch controls to move your chicken around the screen. The controls are simple and intuitive, making it easy to pick up and play. You can also use your controls to jump and dodge obstacles that are coming your way.

As you progress through the levels, you'll encounter different types of food, each with its own point value. Overall, the core gameplay mechanic of Kara - Food Drop is simple yet addictive, making it a great option for players of all ages.
